title: analytics: a dataset or cube dimension over a formula field is accepted at authoring, though every query now refuses it (follow-up to #29304)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyTehJsfYGVMzcXLJD

Follow-up to #29304 (PR #30768), from the contract review [6674767869](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/30768#issuecomment-6674767869), should-fix 1. It is out of scope for that card.

## What happens

Since PR #30768, every analytics face refuses a group over a `formula` field (a virtual field: computed on read, never stored) with `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 at `groupBy.N` and the store-the-value remedy. The faces are `engine.aggregate`, `/analytics/query` on both compositions, `/analytics/sql`, the draft preview and the delegated fallback.

The authoring side does not match:

- `packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-compiler.ts` refuses a virtual field as a dataset **measure** (`REMEDY_BY_SOURCE_CLASS` → the spec's `virtualFieldAggregateRemedy`, #24426). The lint leg `packages/lint/src/validate-dataset-measure-aggregates.ts` prints the same sentence.
- The same compiler accepts a dataset **dimension** over a formula field. `compileDataset`'s dimension loop runs `assertDeclared` and nothing more. A cube dimension whose `sql` names a formula column is accepted the same way.

So an author can publish a dataset or cube whose dimension every query then refuses at 400. The error reaches the dashboard reader at query time, not the author at publish or lint time.

## What is wanted

The authoring-time refusal that Prime Directive 12 asks for: refuse a dataset or cube dimension over a virtual field when the dataset is compiled or published, and in the lint leg, with the same remedy (denormalise the value onto a stored field and group by that). Use the spec's `isVirtualSearchField` / `SEARCH_VIRTUAL_TYPES` as the one predicate, as #29304's query-time doors do.

## Declarations (the reviewer's reading)

- `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`: an authorable dataset or cube shape stops being accepted, so this takes a `minor` changeset of its own.
- Contract-first, so a contract review is owed.

## Links

- #29304 (the query-time refusal), PR #30768, review 6674767869.
- #29167 / PR #29347 (the date-bucket sibling).
- #24426 (the measure-side authoring refusal this would mirror).
